# Connector properties native reference

Original fixture generated by `tools/canvas_connector_fixture.py` from the
project's independently authored preset-lines fixture. It replaces nonvisual
shape properties with connector properties and exercises empty metadata,
empty/active transform locks, both false selection-lock spellings, and start/
end references to two rectangles in the same retained group. No corpus artwork
or third-party rendering engine is included.

The exact source was opened in the reference application and exported without
saving to the adjacent `native.pdf`. `tools/line_reference.py connectors`
extracts eight green-ink bounds and 48 cross-sections at 288 dpi and records
the DOCX SHA-256. Purple endpoint rectangles make the connections visible; the
reference geometry samples focus on the green connectors. Browser checks
compare within 0.75pt through editing, export/reopen and exact package undo.

The WPS schema's choice of cNvSpPr/cNvCnPr and DrawingML connector property
validation are documented in `docs/conformance.md`. No reference/spec rendering
divergence was established by this probe. Rerouting and endpoint editing are
not introduced; retained source geometry remains authoritative.
